propositions: init.py exceeds 800-LOC hard cap at 786 LOC with only 14 lines of headroom
init.py conflates two independent subsystems: tracker provisioning (init_cli/init_core) and tickets-branch convergence units (lazy-imported and dispatched only by ensures._registry())

convergence units and their content templates should extract to _init_ensures.py because ensures.py's own docstring documents that the units live in init.py solely to own the .gitignore/.gitattributes templates

_untrack_runtime_markers_unit and _UNTRACK_BATCH must remain in init.py because test_ensures_untrack_markers.py monkeypatches the constant as an init module attribute and moving it would silently break the multi-batch test path
re-exporting moved symbols from init.py preserves all existing bindings: ensures._registry() attribute access, test imports, and monkeypatch targets
